verdict.rationale: Vercel is a serverless/PaaS deployment platform with ephemeral functions and edge/static hosting rather than a provider of attached block storage volumes for compute instances; the evidence pack shows no concept of 'attached disks' at all, only marketplace-integrated databases (e.g., Neon) which are a separate axis. This 'auto-growing disk with per-byte billing' story is a category mismatch for Vercel's architecture.
